tool_args.rationale: The response is approximately proportional to current input, with small residuals consistent with a damped initial-state transient at the observed long horizons. Fit the two parameters numerically and test on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The small deviations from proportionality plausibly reflect residual dependence on initial state and horizon.
The pilot signature and rows support the simpler two-parameter adiabatic relaxation; a four-parameter coupled mechanism is not yet warranted.
The auxiliary probe is irrelevant to the proposed mechanism.
